app.name: GovPath AI
app.disclaimer: GovPath AI is an informational guide. It does not submit applications, guarantee eligibility or give legal advice. Requirements come from official sources verified on the dates shown; always confirm on the official website before applying.

nav.label: Main navigation
nav.sourcesNote: Requirements quoted from official government sources, with dates.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Plan the steps, documents and order needed to update your address across Indian government services.

services.title: Government services
services.intro: Verified requirements for government services, taken from official sources. Search or filter by life event.
services.loadError: Could not load the service information.
services.searchPlaceholder: Search by service, authority or keyword…
services.noVerifiedInEvent: No services in this life event have been verified yet.
services.coverageNote: GovPath only lists services whose requirements are verified from official sources.

planner.title: Workflow planner
planner.intro: Choose the services you need and tick the documents you already have. GovPath works out the order, what is missing and what to do next.
planner.step1Hint: Suggested services are added from your situation; you can add or remove any.
planner.step2Hint: Tick the documents you already have, such as records being updated and proofs that already show the right details.
planner.selectServiceFirst: Select a service to see the documents it accepts.
planner.tickWhenYouHaveIt: Tick a document once you have it, and the plan will update:
planner.deterministicNote: This plan is calculated by fixed rules from verified official requirements, not by AI.
planner.parallelHint_other: {{count}} independent steps: do them in any order or at the same time
planner.noDependencies: Does not depend on any other step.
planner.missingNoRoute: You need one of these documents. No service in GovPath issues them, so obtain any one yourself.
planner.autoUpdate: The plan updates automatically when you change your selections.
planner.emptyTitle: Select at least one service to begin
planner.emptyHint: Then tick the documents you have and press “Generate my plan”.
planner.unknownIds: Some saved selections are no longer available. Remove them and recalculate?
planner.planError: The plan could not be calculated.
planner.alsoWaiting: Also on hold until these are resolved: {{services}}.

preview.1Text: GovPath checks each selected service against requirements quoted from official sources.
preview.2Text: It works out what must come first, what can run in parallel and which documents unlock later steps.
preview.3Text: Blockers are flagged and one next action is recommended. Change a tick and the plan recalculates.

planner.journeyHint: Numbered stops run in order. Steps at the same stop are independent.
planner.progressNote: Reported by you. GovPath cannot see department records.
planner.routeOutside: {{services}} issues it, but GovPath has verified that service for another state only, so it is not used for {{state}}.
planner.progressSource: Completions are reported by you; ticking documents never completes a service.
planner.docsProduced_one: {{count}} will come from an earlier step
planner.stateNeeded: {{services}} is verified only for {{regions}}. Select where you live in “Your situation” to confirm this route.
planner.noticeEarlyStart: You reported {{service}} as started, but the plan expects {{services}} to finish first.
planner.noticeOutside: {{service}} is verified only for another state, not {{state}}.
planner.noticeProgressOutside: You reported progress on {{service}}, but it is not part of this plan now. Your report is kept and applies again if the service comes back into the plan.
planner.docNotCounted: Not counted until it is valid.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Every document GovPath knows about, which services accept it, and which services issue it.
documents.legendAccepted: Accepted as proof by a service
documents.legendIssued: Issued or updated by a service

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask questions in plain English or Hindi. Answers are AI-generated explanations grounded in official government sources, with citations.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Which documents prove my new address for a passport reissue?
assistant.usePlan: Use my saved plan from the planner
assistant.searching: Searching official sources and preparing an answer…
assistant.example1: Which documents can I use as proof of address for Aadhaar?
assistant.example2: Do I need to update Aadhaar before changing my voter ID address?
assistant.example3: What do I need to change the address on my vehicle RC?
assistant.quotaNote: The assistant uses a limited free AI quota. Repeated questions are answered from cache.
assistant.empty: Ask a question to get an explanation with official sources.
assistant.disclaimer: AI-generated explanation based on the official sources above. It is not an official government decision; please verify on the official website.
assistant.planContext: From your plan (calculated by fixed rules, not AI):

error.quota_exhausted: The AI assistant has reached its usage limit for now. Please try again later — the Services and Planner pages still work.
error.rate_limited: Too many questions in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.assistant_not_configured: The AI assistant is not configured on this server.
error.index_not_built: The assistant's official-source index has not been built yet.
error.model_unavailable: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
error.model_error: The AI service could not produce an answer. Please rephrase and try again.
error.unknown_ids: Your saved plan contains selections that no longer exist. Update it in the planner.
error.validation: Please enter a question between 3 and 1000 characters.
error.generic: Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.

assistant.example4: What documents do I need to register my marriage in Delhi?
assistant.example5: How can I get a PAN card online?
assistant.legendExcerpt: An exact excerpt from an official government page or PDF.
assistant.legendFact: A verified requirement from GovPath's knowledge base, with its source.
assistant.legendAi: The explanation itself is AI-generated and labelled. It never changes facts or your plan.
assistant.planQ1: What is my next step and why?
assistant.planQ2: Which documents am I still missing?
assistant.conversationHint: Answers cite official sources. The plan itself always comes from the planner.

home.title: Know what to do, in what order, with which documents
home.subtitle: GovPath AI turns life events, such as moving home, getting married or having a child, into a personal checklist of government services. Every requirement is backed by official sources.
home.coverage_one: {{count}} government service verified from official sources
home.coverage_other: {{count}} government services verified from official sources
home.lifeEventsHint: Choose what is happening in your life to see the services that may apply.
home.how1Text: Choose the services you need from any life event.
home.how2Text: Mark the documents you already have. Alternatives count.
home.how3Text: See the order, blockers and next step. Ask the assistant for explanations with sources.
home.savedEmpty: You have not started a plan yet. Your selections are saved on this device when you do.
home.trustText: Requirements are taken from official government websites and documents, quoted exactly and dated. The planner uses fixed rules; the assistant only explains them. Coverage is limited to the services listed here.
home.situationPlaceholder: e.g. I got married and want to change my surname
home.situationHint: Opens the assistant with your question. Answers cite official sources.

trust.sourcesText: Every requirement quotes an official government page or document, with its verification date.
trust.rulesText: The order of steps, blockers and next action come from fixed rules over verified data.
trust.aiText: The assistant explains in plain language, cites its sources and says when evidence is missing.

home.savedNotGenerated: Open the planner and generate your plan to see the next step.

flow.1Text: Describe what is happening, or pick a life event.
flow.2Text: See which government services apply and who runs them.
flow.3Text: Every document requirement is quoted from an official source.
flow.4Text: Fixed rules work out the order, blockers and your next step.

situation.title: 1. Your situation
situation.hint: Tell GovPath what you want to achieve and where you live. It suggests the services that apply; you stay in control of the plan.
situation.goalsLabel: What do you want to do?
situation.discoveryError: Suggestions could not be loaded. You can still choose services below.
situation.describeLabel: Or describe it in your own words
situation.describePlaceholder: e.g. I got married in Delhi and want my new surname on my Aadhaar and passport
situation.aiNote: Optional. AI reads your text; you review the result before it is used.
situation.aiBusy: The AI reader is unavailable right now (usage limit). Choose your goals below: everything else works without AI.
situation.aiUnavailable: The AI reader is not available. Choose your goals below: everything else works without AI.
situation.reviewNote: Check these details before using them.
situation.dropped_one: {{count}} item was ignored because GovPath does not recognise it.
situation.dropped_other: {{count}} items were ignored because GovPath does not recognise them.
situation.askRecordWhy: Needed to update an existing record for: {{services}}.
situation.askState: Which state do you live in? {{services}} is verified only for one state.
situation.statusClarify: Answer the question above to include it.
situation.excludedRegion: Not suggested: GovPath has verified this only for {{region}}.
